entities.name: PMID:25095792
observations: Chemical coupling of lactose and dextrans to exposed cytochrome-c lysines using succinimidyl chemistry was tested for structure, activity, and stability.

entities.name: Glycosylated cytochrome-c stability
observations: Chemical lactose/dextran conjugation protected cytochrome c against elevated temperature and humidity, proteolytic degradation, and denaturation at a water-organic solvent interface; conjugates retained at least 94% residual enzyme activity (PMID:25095792).
